    Cyclic zigzag walks (Fischbacher's Lemma 4.4, cyclic form) #

    A cyclic zigzag walk is a linked list of segments whose last peak is its first left peak (ZLinked d₀ L, ZLast d₀ L = d₀). Rotations stay cyclic (zCyc_rotate). A maximal point of the convex hull of the walk is a peak (exists_max_peak), and a front peak of a rotation that meets no other vertex and is maximal in a simply connected hull is not separating (sepComp_front).
